scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @acheron-grid/core && npm run build --workspace @acheron-grid/canvas && npm run build --workspace @acheron-grid/markdown && npm run build --workspace @acheron-grid/react && npm run build --workspace @acheron-grid/vue && npm run build --workspace @acheron-grid/export && npm run build --workspace @acheron-grid/charts
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && npm run typecheck --workspace @acheron-grid/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @acheron-grid/canvas && npm run typecheck --workspace @acheron-grid/markdown && npm run typecheck --workspace @acheron-grid/react && npm run typecheck --workspace @acheron-grid/vue && npm run typecheck --workspace @acheron-grid/export && npm run typecheck --workspace @acheron-grid/charts
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test packages/core/tests/*.test.mjs packages/canvas/tests/*.test.mjs packages/react/tests/*.test.mjs packages/export/tests/*.test.mjs packages/charts/tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.benchmark: npm run build && playwright test --config benchmark.config.mjs
scripts.test:playground: npm run build && playwright test --config playground.config.mjs
